name: help-desk
description: A band above the prompt with Claude's to-do list and the subagents running, plus a /helpdesk pane with the full list and a card per subagent. Read-only.

debug.title: Debug row
debug.description: Always draw a row that says Help Desk is loaded and how many task calls, subagent starts and subagent requests it has seen. Use it to find out why the band is blank. Off by default.
